- The **WhatsApp icon** on the left
- The text **"Chat with us"** in bold white letters
- Below that, **"Online now"** in smaller text with a green dot indicator

However, regarding the **white speech bubble** with the text **"Questions? We reply fast on WhatsApp"**: This specific text is **not visible** in this particular cropped image. The image only displays the green button itself against what appears to be a storefront background (showing "AKIHABARA TCG WAREHOUSE"). 

The white speech bubble with that specific messaging may appear when hovering over the button, or it might be positioned above the visible crop area, but it is not present in the current view of this image.
